description: A barbecue on a sandy beach at sunset. A young woman in a red bandana, an open blue shirt and a denim apron turns sausages and corn on a round black grill with tongs and glares sideways at a big seagull. The seagull stands on a small wooden table beside her next to a plate of burger buns. She turns to it and points her finger at it in warning. A laughing man in a bucket hat and sunglasses stands behind her. Paper lanterns hang on a string above, and a woman in a yellow swimsuit plays volleyball by the sea.
